title: AnchorBinding
description: Shared Anchor Binding grammar — Plan 3.9.0 owns (seeded by 3.7.0; reconcile/extend only). Bus effect classes: inform | block | transform. OAR Decision refinements warn|nudge|allow remain valid block-class values so oar.schema.json can $ref without forking. Do not mint a parallel stage enum — lifecycle is on: <catalog anchor id> only. Base grammar: it declares no additionalProperties, so it stays permissive standalone while a consumer composing it with allOf can close the world; the consumer closes the world (oar.schema.json sets unevaluatedProperties:false plus an ^x- allowance, [OAR-DOC-20]).

on.description: Catalog Anchor id (schemas/anchors.schema.json / lycaon/config/runtime/anchors/). Provisional OAR ids (e.g. tool.pre_invoke.read) are superseded — rewrite at 3.7.4+ migrate.

effect.description: Binding effect. Bus classes: inform (Plan 3.9 render) | block (OAR Decision, including warn|nudge|allow refinements) | transform (content mutate). Shared vocabulary freezes inform|block|transform as the Emit bus classes.

when.description: CEL over the closed typed fact set (Plan 3.7.1 shipped). Required for block/transform after 3.7.1; inform Bindings wire when: by Plan 3.9.4.

render.description: Template id — required when effect is inform (kicks/*.md or inject/*.md stem).

dedup.description: Per-Binding override of Anchor default dedup. Subsumes SignalEvent policy.

tier.description: Authorship tier. builtin = host catalog Bindings; workflow = authored inside workflow.yaml / manifest injects: (Plan 3.9.3). Workflow-scoped Bindings SHOULD set selector.phase and/or selector.workflow.

then.description: Workflow-scoped Binding (Plan 3.9.3): authored under workflow.yaml injects:; selector.phase and/or selector.workflow scope the Binding to a phase/topology.

^x-.description: Implementation extension. Ignored by other implementations ([OAR-DOC-20]).
